title: loadng: fix misleading hop_count clamping security comment
description: Line 564-567 in loadng.rs has a security comment that states the hop_count clamping prevents 'hop_count=0' attacks, but the .min(MAX_HOP_LIMIT) operation only clamps HIGH values, not low ones. Update comment to accurately describe what the clamping protects against (artificially inflated hop counts, metric overflow).
